profile.summary: Aguacero is an artistic, educational and cultural project focused on Puerto Rican Bomba music and dance. Founded in 2006 as a collective of Bay Area artists, it offers performances, lecture demonstrations and workshops for youth and adults, including a youth ensemble called Quenepas.
